result_event.result: [{"item":"①","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.threats","reason":"競爭負向 finding（competitive_share_entrants#0/#2/#4、customer_second_source#0、customer_concentration_credit#0）都已進 threats、R1–R4 與 bear 論述，沒有漏接。"},{"item":"②","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.blind_spots[0]","reason":"supply_demand_durability#2（Toshiba 倍增產能）已引用，並寫進 Bear 機率 32%、R1、Single Thing 與 triggers。"},{"item":"③","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.thesis.R","reason":"關稅、原產地、稀土、替代技術、市場定價等負向 finding 都由 R5、R2、R4、triggers n7 接住；僅 channel_business_model_shift 在 bundle 內無負向條目可對。"},{"item":"④","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.decision_inputs.wait_for_price_condition","reason":"wait_for_price=true 且條件具體可驗（≤320 美元且每 TB 價格年增 ≥0），觀望為規則結果；「價格已反映太多」論證有 Q4 財報後下跌 5.36%、EV/S、P/S 分位等具體內容。"},{"item":"⑤","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"regulatory_antitrust 為 none，3 條查詢切題（antitrust／DOJ／FTC／EU），屬資料級缺口，不算 🔴；但判斷物沒有把該軸缺口或 Kioxia 合併傳聞可能涉及的反壟斷面寫進 blind_spots 或 R6。"},{"item":"⑥","light":"🔴","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.roic_durability.reinvest_rate","reason":"reinvest_rate 只寫「粗估約 5–10%，非實算」，formula_note 只推導內生上界、沒有再投資率算式，也沒用 bundle 內已有的 capex 占營收 4–6% 做可複算推導；roiic 同樣未實算。情境樹（EPS 價差、機率加總 100、五年終價 900／500.5／137.5、EV +20.0%、IRR 5.3%）與 scenario_meta 對帳無誤，endo_ceiling 25 < 共識 CAGR 61% 已在 reasoning 處理。"},{"item":"⑦","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions[管理層說法前後對照].side_a","reason":"稱 Q4 營收 37.5 億「全數超過上緣」，但指引為 36.5 億±1 億（上緣 37.5 億）而實際為 37.47 億，營收未超上緣（q2_moat 也有「營收與毛利率超出指引上緣」的同類寫法）；毛利率確實超標，其餘營運數字與 Q4 FY26 as_of 一致，不改裁決。"},{"item":"⑧","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"20 欄中有變動者（ma、price_at_dd、asym/ev5y/irr、bull/bear 價、p_bull/p_bear、max_dd、rearm_trigger、archetype）都對應到帶 cause 的條目；裁決、角色、signal、val、trap、moat_trend、runway、cycle_position 未變；QC-49 承繼前次觀望且未發火觸發器，方向一致。"}]
